subgoals.name: coverage-filtered complete-case CpG locus set
subgoals.definition: The set of (chr, base, strand) keys in the artifact equals the set of CpG loci that, in every one of the four samples, pass coverage >= 10 (inclusive) and coverage < that sample's 99th coverage percentile (type-7 quantile over the sample's low-passing loci, upper bound exclusive), and that are present in all four filtered samples.

subgoals.name: per-sample count-based percent methylation and group means
subgoals.definition: For every expected locus, the four pct_* columns equal 100 * round(coverage * freqC / 100) / coverage (ties to even) within tolerance, and test_mean_pct / ctrl_mean_pct equal the unweighted means of the corresponding per-sample percentages within tolerance.

subgoals.name: treatment-minus-control difference per locus
subgoals.definition: For every expected locus, diff_pct equals test_mean_pct minus ctrl_mean_pct within tolerance, matching the reference direction (treatment minus control).

tolerances.justification: All graded quantities are percentages in [0, 100]. Exact float or 2-decimal formatting noise is below 0.005 points. A single methylated-count discrepancy shifts a per-sample percentage by 100/coverage >= 1 point for every retained locus (coverage is capped near the 99.9th percentile and always >= 10), and using the file's rounded freqC directly instead of reconstructed integer counts deviates by up to 100/(2*coverage) points, which exceeds 0.05 for essentially all retained loci. 0.05 therefore accepts formatting noise and any ties-to-even/banker's-rounding float discrepancy while rejecting count-reconstruction and aggregation errors.

reward_rule: Reward is the weighted sum of passed subgoals; subgoals failing a dependency are scored as failed. Full success requires every subgoal.

grading.row_matching: by (chr, base, strand) key; row order in the artifact is ignored
